title: Temperature in Degrees Celsius
seo_title: Temperature – Primary 5 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Read temperature on a thermometer in degrees Celsius; find rises and falls in temperature; compare temperatures in towns and find the average temperature. (summary of the NERDC Primary 5 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free Primary 5 maths worksheets on temperature: reading a thermometer, degrees Celsius, rises and falls in temperature, temperatures of Nigerian cities and average temperature. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Water freezes at 0 °C and boils at 100 °C.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Temperature tells us how hot or cold something is. We measure it with a thermometer in degrees Celsius (°C).
  • Find the value of each small mark before you read the scale.
  • A rise in temperature: add. A fall in temperature: subtract. Difference = higher − lower.

Examples

Example

From 23 °C at dawn to 34 °C at noon

34 − 23

Answer: a rise of 11 °C

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Reading the wrong markCount how many degrees each small mark stands for.
Adding for a fall in temperatureA fall means take away.
Writing °FIn Nigeria we use degrees Celsius, °C.
